name: pam_rhosts
detailed_description: Legacy authentication module based on .rhosts and /etc/hosts.equiv files. Provides host-based authentication by trusting specific remote hosts. DEPRECATED and INSECURE - considered obsolete in modern systems due to security vulnerabilities.
notes:
